g.text: The interaction cut, instantiated: from Milner's factoring, through Pi's `Comm` clause, to the generated patterns
LAYER 1 — the schema (†): two introductions meet along matching surfaces
LAYER 2 — the Pi clause that instantiates it
LAYER 3 — the generated data that executes it
partial — defined only when the surfaces match
the AcApp whose remainder absorbs every non-participant
The surface match is the only guard.
occurs in BOTH elements, the AC
and no firing — the term simply rests.
datum migrates through a binder — and the release
has the same cut with an EMPTY release,
so its reduct is the arity-1
the interaction constructor — where contact happens
the program side: the receive, its subject and its abstraction
the environment side: the send, its subject and its objects
the contraction that combines the two continuations
